bio: Although it takes a while to get to this restaurant, following the magical Jezersko valley to a setting just a few kilometres from the Austrian border, once you’ve reached your destination you realise that the journey was well worth it! Surrounded by splendid mountain peaks, this boutique Alpine hotel and its excellent gourmet restaurant of the same name provide a warm, welcoming haven for guests. The chefs here create elegant, refined dishes that showcase the best Slovenian ingredients, paying careful attention to local recipes. Specialities include bear prosciutto served with bread crackers, hazelnut cream and pear, and smoked trout with camomile-flavoured frothed milk, carrot reduction and pickled celery.
